data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 失败驱动的子树补丁经仿真调参和准入后存入库并结晶为确定性BT，供后续任务复用，属外部控制工件持续改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: a three-stage admission pipeline (static check, invariant-monitored replays, an empirical margin over the unpatched tree) admits only patches that demonstrably recover
scope_support.object_quote: When a BT node fails, an LLM proposes a minimal, mission-agnostic subtree patch
scope_support.persistence_quote: Admitted patches are stored in a fleet library and, once the LLM call rate decays, crystallized into a deterministic BT that no human wrote.
